findings.claim: The vendored aggregate check runner ignores the adopter's tool.agent-discipline declaration, causing false layer findings and silently narrowing documentation checks.
findings.reproduction: Compare a mapped-layer per-check invocation with python -m checks over the same tree.
findings.v4_disposition: The canonical project runner must load and report the declaration used by every check; adopter-owned wrappers are forbidden as the shipped solution.

findings.claim: ARCH-004's transitive foreign-import ban conflicts with ARCH-011 when the repository-local shell wires real adapters that own those imports.
findings.reproduction: Use allow_indirect_imports=false with the shell as a forbidden-contract source and import a real adapter from the composition root.
findings.v4_disposition: Separate direct foreign-dependency ownership from permitted runtime wiring and emit distinct diagnostics for each relation.

findings.claim: The exception-code grammar rejects hyphens in codes already published by a component specification.
findings.reproduction: Run exception_has_code against a namespaced leaf such as consink.render.terminal-lost.
findings.v4_disposition: Make the local contract the source of its code grammar and check schema, implementation, tests, and documentation against one generated projection.

findings.claim: A wildcard-ending inline code span in a Python documentation block can abort Doxygen parsing while the doc-style proxy accepts it.
findings.reproduction: Render a documentation block containing a backtick-delimited package wildcard with Doxygen 1.10.0.
findings.v4_disposition: Treat the style check as a proxy with an explicit residual and retain the behavioral Doxygen build verdict.

findings.claim: mutmut 3.3.1 imports the Unix-only resource module before argument parsing and therefore cannot produce a Windows mutation verdict.
findings.reproduction: Import or invoke mutmut 3.3.1 on Windows.
findings.v4_disposition: A release platform may not report an unsupported or not-run binding mechanism as green; use a supported mutation runner or an explicitly equivalent must-reject strategy.

findings.claim: sim-scheduler's inherited prose says to run mypy, but its configuration declares no target, so that exact invocation exits 2; mypy src tests tools passes.
findings.v4_disposition: Generate one canonical gate with explicit repository-local targets and configuration-load probes.

findings.claim: Windows loopback buffering did not deterministically provoke the intended wire-level backpressure fault, while a fault injected at the owned socket seam did.
findings.reproduction: Attempt to saturate a stalled Windows loopback consumer, then inject TimeoutError at the adapter's socket seam.
findings.v4_disposition: Permit controlled seam-level fault evidence while stating that it does not prove OS-level buffer behavior.

findings.claim: Universal comment-presence and physical real/fake/faulty shape rules overstate semantic evidence and can multiply ceremony without increasing discrimination.
observed_in: four v3.2 component adoptions summarized in the v4 roadmap
findings.v4_disposition: Activate evidence by local obligation, accept one implementation realizing several test capabilities, and measure contract/invariant/failure content rather than comment presence alone.
